attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Drift Block. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. SetFrontDrift: set the node/object name this block should use. SetBackDrift: set the node/object name this block should use. Tip: start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need. Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt, L_Wrist_Jnt.
